description: This file is a Bash script named 'pr_cycle.sh' that manages review lifecycle dates for components in a software project, specifically setting or clearing review dates in associated 'metadata.yaml' files for components within a repository. It provides command-line options for starting, stopping, and clearing review cycles, and includes functions for interacting with metadata files, date calculations, and generating reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components with 'metadata.yaml' files excluding docs and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage information and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the path to a component's 'metadata.yaml' file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a future date by adding a specified number of business days.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review lifecycle dates in a metadata YAML file by replacing date entries with tildes (~).

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Runs an external script to regenerate the RAG status report.
